name: SEO Max Content Planner
author: seomaxapp

sections.description:

SEO Max Content Planner: Build SEO Strategies That Actually Rank

Most websites fail at SEO because they don’t have a clear content strategy.

They publish random articles, target random keywords, and never build real authority.

SEO Max Content Planner solves this.

Instead of giving you a list of keywords, it generates a structured and ongoing SEO roadmap — so you always know what to create next.

What you get

  • Generate structured SEO roadmaps continuously
  • Expand your strategy over time with new keyword batches
  • 30 keyword ideas per generation (organized, not random)
  • Build authority step by step
  • Track progress by marking keywords as published
  • Export your roadmap to CSV
  • Uses your own OpenAI API key (no external servers)

Why this plugin is different

Most SEO tools give you data.

This plugin gives you direction.

Instead of guessing what to write next, you get a clear roadmap of what content to create — in the right order — to build authority and rank on Google.

How it works

  1. Add your OpenAI API key
  2. Generate your first roadmap batch
  3. Expand your roadmap over time with new batches
  4. Mark content as published
  5. Build long-term SEO authority

Unlimited usage

Generate as many roadmap batches as you want.

The plugin does not impose any limits — you can continuously expand your SEO strategy over time.

The plugin itself is completely free to use. The only cost involved is your OpenAI API usage — typically just a few cents per generation.

Built for real SEO growth

This plugin is designed for:

  • niche sites
  • bloggers
  • affiliate marketers
  • SEO professionals
  • anyone who wants to grow organic traffic

Next step

Your roadmap is just the beginning.

Turn your keywords into fully optimized SEO articles automatically — including:

  • Complete article content
  • AI-generated images
  • Internal linking
  • SEO-optimized FAQs

From idea to fully optimized content in minutes — with a single click.

→ Explore SEO Max

No data collection

This plugin:

  • does NOT send your data to external servers
  • does NOT track users
  • does NOT store personal information

All API requests are made directly from your WordPress site using your own OpenAI API key.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/seomax-content-planner directory, or install via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the plugin settings and add your OpenAI API key.
  4. Generate your SEO roadmap.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes. The plugin uses your own OpenAI API key to generate SEO roadmaps.

Does this plugin send data to external servers?

No. All requests are made directly from your WordPress site to the OpenAI API. No data is sent to any third-party servers.

Can I use this for any niche?

Yes. The plugin adapts to your niche based on your site content and configuration.

How many keywords are generated?

Each generation creates 30 structured keyword ideas, and you can generate unlimited batches over time.

Is there any usage limit?

No. The plugin does not impose any limits.

You can generate unlimited roadmap batches using your own OpenAI API key.

Is this a keyword research tool?

No. This is a strategic SEO planner, not just a keyword generator.
